images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 1024x1024 seamless game VFX flow texture for a huge magical fire shockwave wall, NOT a rendered scene, NOT a ring. Authored RGBA with real transparent negative spaces. Flat texture field, seamlessly tileable left/right and top/bottom with equal visual density across edges. Dramatic sophisticated flowing magical energy with 4-6 LARGE asymmetric curling flame fronts sweeping diagonally upward, incandescent cream-white/gold narrow inner filaments surrounded by broad rich amber and burnt-orange laminar sheets, deep transparent cavities and torn openings. A strong hierarchy of sweeping macro shapes, delicate smoke-like nested filaments only inside the broad structures, natural fluid turbulence. Think powerful elemental spell material from a beautifully remastered Zelda spell, organically flowing like silk in a furnace, not ordinary stock fire. Detailed but exceptionally readable at gameplay distance. No straight upright flame tips along a bottom strip, no curtain with opaque base, no lava or rock, no lightning branches, no ornaments, no symbols, no radial center, no ice, no blue, no text, no borders, no perspective, no cast shadows, no fake black background. Cover whole tile with an interconnected flow field and about 40% transparent openings. This field will scroll and cross over a second differently scaled sample in game; do not paint fixed cylindrical wall geometry or a staged illustration.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 1024x1024 seamless game VFX flow texture for an enormous released ice-magic shockwave wall. Flat square flow FIELD, NOT a scene or a ring. Authored RGBA on truly transparent background with strong varied alpha. Seamlessly tileable in both axes, equal density at all four edges. A powerful blizzard front captured as 4-6 LARGE diagonal curling sheets of freezing air: broad translucent glacial cyan/steel-blue veils with brilliantly white branching frost ridges and fine feathered hoarfrost crystal growth along their sweeping edges. Strong readable sweeping macro shapes, turbulent flow like a breaking wave frozen into lace, cold refractive ice instead of water. Deep transparent negative-space pockets between the connected sinuous frost ridges; brightest white used selectively. Sophisticated high quality spell texture, dramatic but coherent, airy and immense. The ridges angle consistently upward-right and curl back in long arcs; a few tiny drifting frost grains only secondary. No big standalone crystals, no upright stalagmites, no regular snowflake icons, no rocky surfaces, no lightning forks, no aurora ribbons, no angular geometric mandala, no decorated crown, no bottom stripe or central object, no text/borders/perspective, no black background. About 40% transparent openings. This seamless flow texture will scroll in two differently scaled independent layers around a rapidly expanding wall; do not paint the wall itself.
